items.title: Meta launches Muse personal AI agent in Singapore
items.summary_en: Meta announced that its personal AI agent, Muse, is now available in Singapore. According to the search-result summary, it runs on a dedicated cloud computer called Muse Secure VM, which holds connected-service credentials so that passwords and payment methods are not exposed to the agent.
items.notes: Page not fetched (domain blocked); content from search summary. Exact day unconfirmed.

items.title: Meta partners with five US universities on medical and scientific research
items.summary_en: Meta announced partnerships with Caltech, Ohio State, LSU, Indiana University and UTHealth Houston. According to the search-result summary, the support includes about $2 million in grants and access to Meta's latest models.
